Definition: something hollowed (as a gate), i.e. pupil of the eye
BiblicalUsage: The babah is the pupil of the eye, the little man in the eye — the apple of the eye. Zechariah says he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye, speaking of Jerusalem, the people God guards as tenderly as the eye guards its pupil.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God guards his people the way an eye guards its pupil — with a flinch before the touch even lands — and that is how close I am to him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
